nodes.label: Calibrated Threshold tau_cal = 0.312 (FAR 1.20%, FRR 3.40%)
nodes.rationale: Operating point chosen on the calibration partition and evaluated on held-out test; sits left of the EER point, trading higher FRR for lower FAR.

nodes.label: Equal Error Rate (FAR = FRR line)
nodes.rationale: Diagonal reference line; curve intersects it at roughly 2-3%, approximate EER of the system.

nodes.label: DET Curve (held-out test partition)
nodes.rationale: Log-log DET plot of False Reject Rate vs False Accept Rate on the held-out LibriSpeech test partition. Curve crosses the FAR=FRR diagonal near ~2.5% (approximate EER). Calibrated operating point tau_cal=0.312 gives FAR 1.20%, FRR 3.40%, i.e. the threshold calibrated on a separate partition favors security (low false accepts) over convenience, and generalizes to the test split.

nodes.label: Genuine Trial Scores (n=500)
nodes.rationale: Left-skewed, peak ~0.75, range ~0.1 to ~0.93; a small tail falls below the threshold (false rejects).

nodes.label: Imposter Trial Scores (n=500)
nodes.rationale: Roughly unimodal, mean ~0.08, range ~-0.22 to ~0.33; a handful of imposter trials exceed the threshold (false accepts).

nodes.label: Calibrated Threshold tau_cal = 0.312
nodes.rationale: Decision threshold calibrated on a separate calibration partition and applied to the held-out test partition.

nodes.label: Held-out Test Score Distributions (chart)
nodes.rationale: Overlaid histograms of cosine-similarity scores on the held-out LibriSpeech test partition: imposter trials (n=500) centered near 0.08, genuine trials (n=500) centered near 0.75. Classes are well separated with a small overlap region around 0.2-0.45; the calibrated threshold tau_cal=0.312 sits in this overlap, indicating low FAR/FRR on held-out data.

nodes.label: 192-dim L2-Normalized Speaker Embedding
nodes.rationale: Enrollment stores a vector; no fine-tuning of network weights.

nodes.label: Unified Verification Core Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Demo and batch evaluation share the identical pipeline (ingest -> ECAPA embedding -> combine -> cosine threshold) so benchmarks reflect app behavior.

nodes.label: BaseSpeakerDatasetAdapter Interface
nodes.rationale: Decouples dataset loading so domain-specific (banking) datasets can be plugged in later.

nodes.label: LibriSpeech test-clean Benchmark Results (tau=0.3118, FAR 1.2%, FRR 3.4%)
nodes.norm_label: librispeech test-clean benchmark results (tau=0.3118, far 1.2%, frr 3.4%)
nodes.rationale: App default threshold 0.31 derives from this calibration; LibriSpeech is clean audio so real-world error rates will be higher.

nodes.label: Calibration & Test Independence Protocol
nodes.rationale: No post-hoc EER threshold tuned on the test set; corrupt trials logged rather than suppressed, to keep experimental validity.

nodes.label: Calibration vs Test Speaker Split Protocol
nodes.norm_label: calibration vs test speaker split protocol
nodes.rationale: Threshold chosen on 20 calibration speakers at EER, applied unchanged to 20 disjoint test speakers to avoid optimistic bias.

nodes.label: Cosine Similarity Scoring (not a probability)
nodes.rationale: Cosine similarity measures geometric alignment in [-1,1]; a score is not a probability of same identity.

nodes.label: Configurable Decision Threshold
nodes.rationale: High thresholds minimize false accepts, low thresholds minimize false rejects; must be calibrated on target channel audio.

nodes.label: Strictly Local Processing & Minimal Retention
nodes.rationale: Biometric data never leaves the machine; raw audio discarded; data/ excluded via .gitignore; FastAPI bound to 127.0.0.1 with restricted CORS.

nodes.label: Multi-Sample Enrollment (mean + L2 normalization)
nodes.rationale: Combining several takes into one template yields a more robust profile without retaining raw audio.
